11	def _fake_qmd_run(qmd_dir: Path):
12	    """A stand-in for the real qmd binary: only implements `collection add`
13	    and `collection remove` against the YAML config file, mirroring the real
14	    tool's own behavior closely enough to exercise the round trip."""
15	
16	    class FakeCompleted:
17	        def __init__(self, returncode=0, stdout="", stderr=""):
18	            self.returncode = returncode
19	            self.stdout = stdout
20	            self.stderr = stderr
21	
22	    def fake_run(cmd, **kwargs):
23	        config_path = qmd_dir / "index.yml"
24	        data = {}
25	        if config_path.is_file():
26	            data = yaml.safe_load(config_path.read_text()) or {}
27	        data.setdefault("collections", {})
28	
29	        if cmd[:3] == ["qmd", "collection", "add"]:
30	            path = cmd[3]
31	            name = None
32	            pattern = "**/*.md"
33	            i = 4
34	            while i < len(cmd):
35	                if cmd[i] == "--name":
36	                    name = cmd[i + 1]
37	                    i += 2
38	                elif cmd[i] == "--mask":
39	                    pattern = cmd[i + 1]
40	                    i += 2
41	                else:
42	                    i += 1
43	            name = name or Path(path).name
44	            if name in data["collections"]:
45	                return FakeCompleted(returncode=1, stderr=f"Collection '{name}' already exists.\n")
46	            data["collections"][name] = {"path": path, "pattern": pattern}
47	            qmd_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
48	            config_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(data))
49	            return FakeCompleted(stdout=f"Collection '{name}' created successfully\n")
50	
51	        if cmd[:3] == ["qmd", "collection", "remove"]:
52	            name = cmd[3]
53	            if name not in data["collections"]:
54	                return FakeCompleted(returncode=1, stderr=f"Collection not found: {name}\n")
55	            del data["collections"][name]
56	            config_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(data))
57	            return FakeCompleted(stdout=f"Removed collection '{name}'\n")
58	
59	        if cmd == ["qmd", "update"]:
60	            return FakeCompleted(stdout="All collections updated.\n")
61	
62	        if cmd == ["qmd", "embed"]:
63	            return FakeCompleted(stdout="Embedded 0 chunks from 0 documents\n")
64	
65	        return FakeCompleted(returncode=1, stderr="unsupported in test double")
66	
67	    return fake_run

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Manual smoke test for `wakil init` / `wakil qmd sync` on a fresh workspace.
# Runs against the REAL qmd binary (no mocking) — verifies actual end-to-end behavior.
set -uo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="/Users/ebridges/Projects/wakil"
KB="/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ebridges-Projects-wakil/6f77ae00-a4f5-49eb-b09b-3fa836b62e4c/scratchpad/qmd-smoke-kb"
PASS=0
FAIL=0

check() {
    local desc="$1"; shift
    if "$@"; then
        echo "  PASS: $desc"
        PASS=$((PASS+1))
    else
        echo "  FAIL: $desc"
        FAIL=$((FAIL+1))
    fi
}

run() {
    echo "+ $*"
    "$@"
}

cd "$REPO_ROOT" || exit 1

echo "=== 0. Fresh workspace setup ==="
rm -rf "$KB"
mkdir -p "$KB"
cat > "$KB/note-one.md" <<'EOF'
---
title: Note One
---

# Note One

This is a durable note about wakil's QMD sync smoke test.
EOF
cat > "$KB/note-two.md" <<'EOF'
---
title: Note Two
---

# Note Two

A second note linking to [[Note One]].
EOF
check "seed notes created" test -f "$KB/note-one.md" -a -f "$KB/note-two.md"

echo
echo "=== 1. wakil init ==="
run uv run wakil init "$KB"
INIT_EXIT=$?
check "init exit code 0" test "$INIT_EXIT" -eq 0
check ".wakil/config.yml created" test -f "$KB/.wakil/config.yml"
check ".wakil/qmd/index.yml created" test -f "$KB/.wakil/qmd/index.yml"
check "workspace db created" bash -c "ls '$KB'/.wakil/*.db >/dev/null 2>&1"

echo
echo "=== 2. wakil status (post-init) ==="
run uv run wakil -w "$KB" status

echo
echo "=== 3. wakil qmd collection list (should show default collection from init) ==="
run uv run wakil -w "$KB" qmd collection list
COLLECTION_OUTPUT=$(uv run wakil -w "$KB" qmd collection list 2>&1)
echo "$COLLECTION_OUTPUT" | grep -q "$(basename "$KB")"
check "default collection registered by init" test $? -eq 0

echo
echo "=== 4. wakil qmd sync (should be a no-op: collection already exists) ==="
run uv run wakil -w "$KB" qmd sync
SYNC_EXIT=$?
check "qmd sync exit code 0" test "$SYNC_EXIT" -eq 0
SYNC_OUTPUT=$(uv run wakil -w "$KB" qmd sync 2>&1)
echo "$SYNC_OUTPUT" | grep -qi "no new collections"
check "qmd sync reports no-op once collection exists" test $? -eq 0

echo
echo "=== 5. wakil qmd sync on a workspace initialized WITHOUT the default collection ==="
KB2="${KB}-no-collection"
rm -rf "$KB2"
mkdir -p "$KB2"
cp "$KB/note-one.md" "$KB2/"
run uv run wakil init "$KB2" --no-qmd-collection
INIT2_EXIT=$?
check "init --no-qmd-collection exit code 0" test "$INIT2_EXIT" -eq 0
NOCOLL_OUTPUT=$(uv run wakil -w "$KB2" qmd collection list 2>&1)
echo "$NOCOLL_OUTPUT" | grep -qi "No QMD collections registered"
check "no collection registered after --no-qmd-collection" test $? -eq 0

run uv run wakil -w "$KB2" qmd sync --yes
SYNC2_EXIT=$?
check "qmd sync --yes exit code 0" test "$SYNC2_EXIT" -eq 0
AFTER_SYNC2=$(uv run wakil -w "$KB2" qmd collection list 2>&1)
echo "$AFTER_SYNC2" | grep -q "$(basename "$KB2")"
check "qmd sync --yes registers the default collection" test $? -eq 0

echo
echo "=== 6. wakil search sanity check (exercises the qmd index end-to-end) ==="
run uv run wakil -w "$KB" search "smoke test"

echo
echo "=== Summary ==="
echo "PASS: $PASS  FAIL: $FAIL"
if [ "$FAIL" -ne 0 ]; then
    exit 1
fi

## Summary

- Adds a third DAG node (`EntityRevision`) that deterministically merges enrichment output into *existing* entity notes instead of only ever creating new ones, scoped to `compiled-truth-timeline`-shaped entity types.
- Makes entity schemas resolvable kb-local/user/built-in (mirroring skill resolution) and introduces a `page_shape` axis (`compiled-truth-timeline` / `single-occurrence`) with its own override-able templates.
- Several ingest-quality improvements: reconciling proposed-note wikilinks against entity-resolution's answer, finding existing entity pages by name (not just relevance), parsing Apple `.whisper` transcript archives natively, and making raw capture paths workspace-relative/citation-linkable.
- Moves QMD's index/collections to a workspace-scoped `.wakil/qmd/` directory, adds `wakil qmd sync/embed` and `wakil qmd collection add/list/remove`, and auto-refreshes the index after ingest/enrich.
- Adds `wakil skills describe`, a `🐛 fix(fts)` snippet-highlighting bug fix, and doc updates to `note-conformance`/`note-routing`/`entity-resolve`/`ingest-source` skills.

## Test plan

- [x] `uv run pytest` — 317 passed, 51 deselected

- [ ] Manual smoke test of `wakil qmd sync` / `wakil init` on a fresh workspace
